short_description: Build and verify playable browser games.
description: Design, implement, tune, and verify browser games with optional SandBase-generated concept art and game assets.

requires: A local browser-game project and runtime
An authorized SandBase connection only for optional generated assets

install.prompt: Use $game-dev to build and verify this playable browser game.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill game-dev --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill game-dev --agent codex --global

examples: Build a playable 3D browser game from this short design brief.
Add a deterministic demo mode and verify the core loop in screenshots.
Create an approved SandBase concept-art batch, then integrate the assets into the game.

optional_inputs: controls, mechanics, art direction, and target devices
authorized SandBase connection for generated assets

notes: Game code, builds, tests, and deterministic asset processing remain local.
Optional generated assets use dynamically inspected SandBase capabilities with paid-call confirmation.
Deployment is separate unless the user explicitly requests it.

endpoints.summary: Discover current image and game-asset generation capabilities.
Inspect live asset schemas, formats, limits, and pricing.
Recover recent run status and observed cost.
Check balance before an approved asset batch.
